about: What the dashboard shows and why (SQMeter spec 025; the Status card, SQMeter spec 026). The Status card shows only what no other card shows: the imaging app and whether alerts go out, plus problems nothing else shows (DS-08). Every field of the status, readings, safety and alerts-armed schemas and every settings-dependency id is mapped here: shown (with a test in web/tests/dashboard.spec.ts) or not shown (with a reason). Checked by tools/dashboard/check.py (DASH-02).

visibility.when: send mode is "only while an imaging app is connected" and Alpaca is off
alerts are on but no enabled channel can send

shown.label: status.imagingApp
shown.requiredBy: 025 FR-009, 021, 026 FR-002 (amended: Status card shows only what no other card does)
shown.note: One tile per Alpaca device (the roof's Dome, spec 006): connected, gone quiet or waiting, and when it last checked. No tile while there is no Alpaca device (the demo) or Alpaca is off.

shown.label: status.clock
shown.requiredBy: 025 FR-016, 005, 026 FR-002 (amended: Status card shows only what no other card does)

visibility.when: the clock is not set

shown.label: glance.needs.state

visibility.when: a group follows SQMeter and SQMeter has a secret RoofRoof lacks (MQTT password, ntfy token)

shown.note: A note row per secret to enter, linking to its Settings tab; never a problem.
shown.demoCannot: The demo keeps its MQTT and alerts groups set locally, so it never needs a secret

shown.label: stage.finish

visibility.when: a roof setup stage is still to do (one the test box bypasses counts under the test box row)

shown.note: One note row, Finish setup: <first stage left>, linking to that stage; the full list is in Settings, Roof.

shown.label: testBox.check.bypassed

visibility.when: a test box bypass is in effect

shown.note: A note row linking to the test box page: the card never says All good while a check is bypassed.

visibility.when: a motion fault is latched
the automatic close is held by a person, can't move or has halted

shown.label: roof.title
shown.note: The Roof card: the state pill (Fault while one is latched).

shown.label: roof.open
shown.note: Open, Close and Stop. Spec 034: one short line per button with its first reason (from lib/moveBlockers.ts, e.g. 'Open: Weather unsafe'), the full reasons only in the move dialog a press opens; no line where the state pill or the fault already says it (at that end, moving there, a fault), only the button's tooltip. A disabled button's own reason (no live data, restarting, the setup hotspot, the stuck park switch check, a waiting close) is the line.

shown.label: roof.daylight.label

visibility.when: the device reports the daylight check (older firmware doesn't)

shown.note: The sun's reading as the device words it, the mode behind '?'. Under it where the location came from, or (spec 034) which one is kept, with why behind the '?'. When daylight closes the roof, Open's line says so in a few words.

visibility.when: the supply always; the motor current while current sense is on; the park switches when fitted
a motion fault is latched

shown.label: roof.pinsLink

visibility.when: the pin setup is invalid (the fault above says why)

shown.note: A link to the Pins page under the roof's fault.
shown.demoCannot: The demo device refuses an invalid pin set, so its pins are always valid

shown.label: roof.mount.label

visibility.when: the firmware reports it (spec 043 and later)

shown.note: One row under Mount park: May move at either magnet, Keep still otherwise, why behind its ?. The same fact N.I.N.A. reads as the Alpaca Switch "Mount may move"; said nowhere else.

visibility.when: the automatic close isn't idle
unsafe weather is counting towards the automatic close (not rain, not yet fired)

shown.label: roof.blindClosing

visibility.when: the roof is closing blind (the Hall sensor failed)

shown.demoCannot: The demo roof has no failed Hall sensor to inject, so it never closes blind

shown.label: glance.ethernet

visibility.when: the board in effect has Ethernet

shown.note: The link as a pill and the Ethernet address; speed, MAC and IPv6 are on the System page and Settings -> Network.
shown.demoCannot: The demo's board is an ESP32 DevKit, which has no Ethernet

visibility.when: IPv6 is on
mDNS is on
MQTT is on

shown.label: setup.notFinished

visibility.when: the setup state is new (after the wizard has opened once in this page load) or offered (after an upgrade)

shown.note: From the settings (setup.state), not the status: outside the card grid, in the bench banner's slot.

shown.label: roof.parkWait.bar

visibility.when: an Open or Close waits for the mount to park, or the last wait failed

shown.note: A note with the command, whether N.I.N.A. was asked and the time left, with Stop; a failed wait's reason as a warning note.
shown.demoCannot: The demo core with spec 027's park wait, overrides and source health is rebuilt separately; until then the card is tested with each state set directly

shown.label: move.dialog.openAnyway

visibility.when: a person's override is in effect, or Open is pressed while blocked

shown.note: The overrides in effect as a warning note; the overridable reasons decide whether the move dialog offers Open anyway.
shown.demoCannot: The demo core with spec 027's park wait, overrides and source health is rebuilt separately; until then the card is tested with each state set directly

shown.label: diagnostics.sources

visibility.when: SQMeter is on or a N.I.N.A. address is set

shown.note: When SQMeter and N.I.N.A. last answered, behind the weather and park rows' "?"; a silent SQMeter or unreachable N.I.N.A. as a short warning note under its row, the device's reason behind the same "?" (spec 034).
shown.demoCannot: The demo core with spec 027's park wait, overrides and source health is rebuilt separately; until then the card is tested with each state set directly
